digest.component_or_area: live Jira DC harness + inbound/outbound differ + rich-text codec
propositions: The live DC harness's rich-text test must assert rendered HTML via ?expand=renderedFields (heading/bold/code-macro) after pushing a body via rebar.edit_ticket, not just wiki source
A second reconcile pass must emit no inbound description mutation (state-based echo-safety), proving the landed rich body decodes to an unchanged value under the outbound codec's map_fields_to_remote

A both-sides concurrent edit (rebar-side AND Jira-side to description before the next pass) must keep rebar's body (local-wins) and record a deduped outbound-field-conflict alert with the remote value preserved
The inbound differ must apply map_fields_to_remote (mirror of outbound _baseline_form_matches) so a Jira echo of the local pushed body is recognized as unchanged and emits no inbound mutation
normalize_rich_text must maintain a stable public signature and behavior to guard breaking changes in the agentic-dev-platform cross-repo import
